answer: A bond is refunded only after 32 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The reef counter is kept in saffron and jade shows each reset. A hostile operator therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 32 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 3053 identities would post 1380 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
